_doc: THE one declaration of where My Movies (web, c_Circus/movies) and cloud-media-center (Android, cloud-u-android/ac_cloud-media-center, copied in by data/regen.py at a pinned commit) may look for a title. LEGAL SOURCES ONLY: the user's own servers and files, official stores via TMDB watch/providers, official trailers, and public-domain / Creative-Commons catalogues. Unlicensed streaming embeds and public torrent indexes are forbidden; legal-denylist.json (beside this file, never bundled into an app) is grepped over both repos by the legal guard (tests/legal-guard.sh here, test/test-media-center-legal.sh in Android), which skips only that file and the guard itself. Secrets are never committed: each app asks for them in its own settings screen and keeps them on the device. To add a source: append an entry with a known `kind`; the picker orders by `order`.

sources.name: Emby
sources._doc: Emby speaks the same Items API as Jellyfin under /emby.

sources.name: Cloud drive
sources._doc: The cloud-shared-store / cloud-drive media folder served over HTTP: {url}/index.json lists [{name, path}] (or a plain array of paths). A file matches when its name holds the IMDb id, or the title and year.

sources.name: Files on this device
sources._doc: Files the user picks (file input / folder). Matched like drive; played from a blob URL, nothing uploaded.

sources.name: Official trailer
sources._doc: TMDB /{movie|tv}/{id}/videos: an official YouTube Trailer, embedded from youtube-nocookie.com.

sources.name: Where to watch
sources._doc: TMDB /{movie|tv}/{id}/watch/providers for the region: flatrate / free / ads / rent / buy, each a logo and a deep link (provider_links below, else TMDB's region page).

sources.name: Internet Archive
sources._doc: Public-domain feature films, matched by title and year; plays the item's MP4 from archive.org/download, or its official per-item torrent.

sources.name: Blender open movies
sources._doc: Official direct downloads from download.blender.org (CC-BY). Blender publishes no live official torrents (checked 2026-10-17), so this is HTTP only.

sources.name: Internet Archive torrents
sources._doc: The Archive's own per-item .torrent (it webseeds from archive.org, so the browser can stream it). The only searchable torrent source.

dropped.name: Public Domain Torrents
dropped.why: does not answer (connection fails on http and https)

dropped.name: VODO
dropped.why: does not answer (connection fails on http and https)

dropped.name: Legit Torrents
dropped.why: only a static memorial page; every catalogue/search/RSS path is 404

dropped.name: Academic Torrents
dropped.why: live, but browse is anti-scrape and rss.xml/database.xml send no CORS header, so neither app (both run in a browser engine) can read it

dropped.name: Blender official torrents
dropped.why: no .torrent files are published; the films are kept as direct downloads (source 'blender')

provider_links._doc: TMDB provider_id -> a search deep link on the service ({title} is URL-encoded). Android opens these in the service's own app via the system (app links); anything not listed opens TMDB's region page.
